players.product: AI cloud computing power (GPU clusters on long-term contracts) and the StarFlow Model-as-a-Service platform; the strategic cloud platform of the Xiaomi and Kingsoft ecosystem

quarterly_data.signal: Kingsoft Cloud's Q2 2026 results release (6-K exhibit): enterprise cloud services revenue was RMB714.3 million, down 1.3% year-over-year from RMB723.9 million and up 1.0% from RMB707.4 million in Q1 2026. GAAP operating profit was RMB23.0 million (operating margin 0.7%), versus an operating loss of RMB327.0 million a year earlier and RMB166.1 million in Q1 2026 - CEO Tao Zou: 'we recorded positive operating margin (GAAP) for the first time'. Net loss narrowed to RMB93.0 million from RMB456.9 million a year earlier; Non-GAAP EBITDA margin was 35.8% (17.3% a year earlier). Net cash generated from operating activities was RMB2,850,866 thousand in the quarter. Cash and cash equivalents fell to RMB4,674.3 million from RMB6,018.0 million at December 31, 2025, mainly due to investment in the procurement of computing power equipment.
